title: Anchor-based contrast suite and ranked-pair concordance eval for embedding+reranker
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Build an offline evaluation harness that ties config changes and model swaps to concrete embedding + reranker quality signals. The suite will: (1) construct anchor queries from production cohorts, (2) generate hard negatives and synthetic paraphrase negatives, (3) run the embedding + reranker pipeline to produce ranked lists, and (4) compute a small, interpretable metric set including recall@K, precision@K, MRR, ranked-pair concordance, and embedding-space shift scores. The goal is to produce a delta report for every config/model change that can be used to gate rollouts and trigger automated investigations. The harness should be fast enough for nightly pre-merge runs on sampled cohorts and robust enough to run as part of CI for significant config PRs.
acceptance_criteria: Anchor builder that samples 10k production queries into length and intent buckets and stores anchors in s3/glacier-friendly layout
Negative generator supporting: (a) nearest-neighbor hard negatives, (b) paraphrase-synth negatives from the paraphrase model, and (c) random negatives
Metrics computed per-anchor and aggregated with bootstrap confidence intervals: recall@1/5/10, precision@5, MRR, ranked-pair concordance (RPC), and centroid cosine shift
Delta report produced for any model/config change (human-readable + machine-readable JSON) with pass/fail flags based on configurable thresholds
Integration with Console alerting: failing delta report creates an alert and links to failing anchors and example trace links
End-to-end run on the sampled cohort completes within 20 hours on dedicated CI hardware (target <24h)
Documented runbook for triage and rollback based on the delta report
implementation_notes: Re-use the replay extraction pipeline (ENG-58120) to build the anchor cohort — add a filtered export that preserves query metadata (user-intent tag, session id, client app)
Represent config fingerprints as a hash over model-id, tokenizer-version, pooling-strategy, quantization-bits, reranker-weights to detect any relevant change
Compute RPC by sampling pairwise orderings from ground-truth positives vs negatives and measure concordance with model rank; bootstrap for CI
Embedding-space shift: compute distributional summaries (mean cosine to centroid, variance, approximate KL between cosine histograms) and bucket by query length and cohort
Store per-anchor results and artifacts (rank lists, logits, cached KV pointers) for 30 days in s3 for debugging
Expose a small JSON schema for delta reports so automation can parse and gate; fields: fingerprint, baseline_metrics, candidate_metrics, deltas, pass_fail_reason, top_failing_anchors
test_plan: Unit tests for anchor sampling logic and negative generator with deterministic seeds
Synthetic perturbation suite: add character-level noise, paraphrase-level semantic drift, and tokenization shifts to measure sensitivity
A/B shadow-run comparing baseline model vs candidate model on a stable 'gold' anchor set to validate RPC and recall deltas
End-to-end smoke run triggered by a config PR (tokenizer change / quantization switch) to validate CI integration
Manual review by PM/Design on first 3 failing delta reports to confirm actionable signal before automating rollbacks
